findings.title: Swallowed append_actor_events error now allows partial per-emitter state persistence (half-updated state / possible fork)
findings.reason: COW-2435 replaced the single append with a per-emitter BTreeMap loop, each call `if let Err(e) = ... { warn! }`; append_actor_events writes merkleized state (state_pending under StateKey::actor_events), so a node-local storage error persists earlier emitters, skips later ones, and diverges the state root from validators where all appends succeeded — a fork-class half-update the surrounding code otherwise propagates with `?`.

findings.title: Emitter normalization table is incomplete: governance/CIP-34/CIP-7/runner system events are attributed to tx.from and now persisted into the sender's actor log
findings.reason: system_event_emitter has arms only for Upgrade/CBSS/Token/Library; every other event-emitting System instruction (e.g. governance.circuit.paused, cip34.IntentSettled, cip7.stream.*) falls to `_ => None`, so the placeholder tx.from emitter is committed into logs_root and — via the new unconditional grouped persistence — written to the tx sender's actor event log (previously not persisted at all), mislabeling provenance the PR claims to fix (governance events attributed to an arbitrary user rather than GOVERNANCE_SYSTEM_ACTOR 0x09); deterministic, so not a fork.

findings.title: Governance/entitlement/proposal system events mis-attributed to tx.from instead of their system actor (0x09)
findings.reason: system_event_emitter only maps CBSS/Token/Upgrade/Library; every other SystemInstruction (CircuitBreaker, Submit*Proposal, ExecuteProposal, EndorseProposal, Entitlement*, ExecutorRegistryPin/Unpin, council) falls to `_ => None`, so events emitted on GOVERNANCE_SYSTEM_ACTOR (0x09)'s behalf keep emitter=tx.from (the EOA), violating the documented 'emitter = actual producer' invariant and committing wrong provenance into logs_root/bloom/state_root.

findings.title: system_event_emitter omits RAS/runner/job/delegation/governance/trading-post families → their system events committed with emitter = tx.from (caller), not the system actor
findings.reason: Only UpgradeActor/CBSS/Token variants are enumerated; every other SystemInstruction that pushes to self.system_events (ras.rs ras.por.*, delegation.rs cip13.*, JobSubmit/RunnerRegister, governance) hits `_ => None`, so events keep the placeholder emitter=tx.from set in transaction.rs and are baked into logs_root (consensus/flag-day) plus the caller's actor event index — mis-attributing system-actor provenance to the sender, the exact forgeable-provenance class COW-2435 claims to close.

findings.title: RPC TransactionReceiptResponse.events changed from positional 2-tuple to 3-tuple — silent index shift for external HTTP consumers; inconsistent with indexer's additive object form
findings.reason: events serializes as a positional JSON array; going (topic,data)→(emitter,topic,data) moves topic/data to index [1]/[2], so any off-repo consumer reading events[i][0] as topic breaks, and client/src/rpc.rs `#[serde(default)]` cannot deserialize an old 2-element array (arity mismatch, not defaulted) — node and client must roll in lockstep; note the indexer JSON uses an additive {emitter,topic,data} object, so the two RPC surfaces now expose different event shapes.

findings.title: ActorEvent/TransactionReceipt persisted codec inserts 20-byte emitter mid-struct with no version gate → all pre-upgrade receipts/events unreadable
findings.reason: emitter is read before topic unconditionally (unlike tail-appended tx_type/tx_sub_type which are has_remaining-gated), so any receipt/ActorEvent persisted before the upgrade misparses (reads topic-length bytes as the address) — a hard DB-wipe state migration beyond the logs_root golden the PR flags, must be part of the flag-day rollout.

findings.title: Per-emitter event-log grouping turns one tx into N full read-modify-write of 1000-entry logs
findings.reason: New by_emitter BTreeMap appends events to every distinct emitter's log; each append_actor_events deserializes+trims+reserializes that actor's up-to-MAX_ACTOR_EVENTS(1000) ActorEventList uncharged, so a tx nesting into K distinct emitting actors does O(K*1000) log-serialization work vs one log in the old code — a superlinear amplification relative to per-emit gas.

findings.title: Unmatched System instructions (RAS/trading_post/delegation/governance) misattributed to tx.from
findings.reason: system_event_emitter's `_ => None` fallthrough leaves the tx.from placeholder as emitter for system events that are semantically emitted on behalf of a fixed system actor (contradicting its own docstring), committing them to logs_root and persisting them to the sender's log under a delegate/relayer address rather than the true emitter — provenance is under-attributed (safe self-assert direction, but incorrect).

findings.title: Unconditional 20-byte emitter prefix in logs_root/bloom/receipt/ActorEvent forks a mixed-version network (no activation gate)
findings.reason: compute_logs_root, compute_bloom, TransactionReceipt codec and ActorEvent codec all now embed emitter unconditionally, so a node running the new code produces different logs_root/receipt_root (and, via StateValue::ActorEventList, different state_root) than an un-upgraded peer for every event-emitting tx — the diff has no height/version gate, so any non-atomic rollout forks. Flag-day change requiring coordinated activation.

findings.title: Nested-call events re-attributed to the callee's log change which state keys are written (state_root shift for existing inputs)
findings.reason: Old code appended all of a tx's events to the single tx-level actor log; per-emitter BTreeMap grouping now writes events to the callee's StateKey::actor_events (and applies MAX_ACTOR_EVENTS trimming per-emitter), which is merkleized state, so the exact same historical block yields a different state_root — deterministic but a committed-byte attribution shift that must ride the same flag-day and re-audited golden.

findings.title: Unmatched system instructions (_ => None) now commit tx.from as emitter and persist to its event log
findings.reason: system_event_emitter returns None for non-token/non-cbss/non-upgrade system ops, so their events keep the placeholder tx.from injected in transaction.rs; previously such events had actor_addr=None and were NOT persisted to any actor log — now they are both committed into logs_root with a tx.from emitter and written to tx.from's ActorEventList, adding new consensus state for any such event-emitting system op. Deterministic but a bytes-changing provenance shift bundled into the flag-day.

findings.title: TransactionReceipt/ActorEvent Read gains an unversioned 20-byte emitter field, misparsing pre-upgrade persisted records
findings.reason: ActorEvent::read and TransactionReceipt::read now unconditionally consume a 20-byte Address before topic for each event with no version discriminator; on restart after upgrade, records persisted in the old (emitter-less) format are misparsed (20 bytes stolen from topic/length), so any node re-reading old local receipts/event logs post-flag-day gets corrupt or failed deserialization unless the store is wiped.
